title: Smooth transfer between maps without fade

posts.body:
Is there any way to transfers between maps by smooth camera movement, or something like that, without fading out ?

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
What do you mean by smooth camera movement? You mean like you'd put 2 maps aside each other and then slide one out while the other slides in? Like the original Zelda game?
Nah, that isn't how the engine works. That would specially a problem when going from one map and land on a map with different tilesets used.
I am not going so far as to say it is impossible, (after all, if Zelda could do it in the 80's, then it should be possible in 2024) but this is at least not something I've seen in RPG maker before.
--
While I type this, I see
@Mac15001900
has a solution... But after a quick glance, I think this plugin is not meant to go from map to map, but to use one large map and have the plugin cut it in pieces.
If that is what you wanted, than this plugin might help. Just keep in mind that:
1. You can only use a single tileset if all your maps are on the same map.
2. Even though only part of the map is shown, the whole map will be loaded, which for huge maps might cause lag. Specially on older computers and when using animated auto-tiles.
